title: Hero -> Model B robustness consumer machine-readable report (#425)
description: Deterministic, machine-readable report emitted by the #425 adapter/runner tools/simulation/model_b_hero_robustness_adapter.py. The adapter is the end-to-end chain: synthetic fixture load -> fail-closed #425 contract validation -> projection onto the additive #344 sensitivity harness request -> #344 run_harness execution against the persisted #340 candidate/reference evidence -> #425 Hero robustness classification. The report binds the consumed input contract (input_schema_ref), the single closed-vocabulary verdict (status), its sorted reason codes, the all-false information boundary, synthetic provenance references and the two content hashes (harness_request_sha256 over the projected #344 request, harness_report_sha256 over the #344 report). Every object pins additionalProperties=false and every provenance/boundary flag is a pinned const, so a report can never be enriched with a real #367/#314/VALIDATION/TEST claim after the fact. The report carries no timestamp and no host path, so two runs over the same synthetic fixture are byte-identical.

input_schema_ref.description: $id of the fail-closed #425 input contract the fixture was validated against.

status.description: The exact closed #425 verdict vocabulary; no other value may ever be emitted.

reason_codes.description: Sorted, non-empty reason codes supporting the verdict; a fail-closed verdict must be legible.

information_boundary.description: Every #425 boundary flag is pinned false: the report never claims to have consumed Hero EV, Model A, a recommendation, a future card, an unrevealed opponent hole card or the route/source label as a predictive target.

provenance.description: Synthetic provenance references: the report derives from a synthetic #425 fixture and a synthetic-only #344 harness request, and it never consumed real #367/#314 evidence, a VALIDATION hand or a TEST hand.

harness_request_sha256.description: canonical_sha256 of the projected #344 harness request actually executed.

harness_report_sha256.description: report_sha256 of the #344 run_harness report produced by that request.
